  • kafka.hg.8u16g.cluster
  • kafka.hg.16u32g.cluster
  • kafka.hg.32u64g.cluster
    集群版 鲲鹏-计算增强型的规格可选为：
  • kafka.kp.2u4g.cluster

  • kafka.kp.8u16g.cluster
  • kafka.kp.16u32g.cluster
  • kafka.kp.32u64g.cluster
    单机版 计算增强型的规格可选为：
  • kafka.2u4g.single
  • kafka.4u8g.single
  • kafka.8u16g.single
    单机版 海光-计算增强型的规格可选为：
  • kafka.hg.2u4g.single

  • kafka.hg.8u16g.single
    单机版 鲲鹏-计算增强型的规格可选为：
  • kafka.kp.2u4g.single
  • kafka.kp.4u8g.single
  • kafka.kp.8u16g.single","lowerObject":"","example":"
  • 集群版：kafka.8u16g.cluster
  • 单机版：kafka.4u8g.single"},{"support_auto_recovery":"nodeNum","isRequir":"是","paramType":"Integer","describe":"节点数，取值范围1,3~50。

  • 当specName为集群版规格时取值为3~50","lowerObject":"","example":"3"},{"support_auto_recovery":"zoneList","isRequir":"是","paramType":"Array of Strings","describe":"实例所在可用区信息。
  • 当specName为单机版规格时只能填一个（单可用区）

    可用区信息可调用 资源池可用区查询 API接口查询。","lowerObject":"","example":"[\"cn-huadong1-jsnj1A-public-ctcloud\"]"},{"support_auto_recovery":"diskType","isRequir":"是","paramType":"String","describe":"磁盘类型，资源池所具备的磁盘类型可通过查询产品规格 API接口查询，默认取值：

  • SSD：超高IO
  • FAST-SSD：极速型SSD","lowerObject":"","example":"SSD"},{"support_auto_recovery":"diskSize","isRequir":"是","paramType":"Integer","describe":"单个节点的磁盘存储空间，单位为GB，存储空间取值范围100~30000，并且为100的倍数。实例总存储空间为diskSize * nodeNum。","lowerObject":"","example":"300"},{"support_auto_recovery":"vpcId","isRequir":"是","paramType":"String","describe":"VPC网络ID。获取方法如下：
  • 方法一：登录网络控制台界面，在虚拟私有云的详情页面查找VPC ID。
  • 方法二：您可以通过 查询VPC列表 vpcID字段获取。","lowerObject":"","example":"vpc-grqvu4741a"},{"support_auto_recovery":"subnetId","isRequir":"是","paramType":"String","describe":"VPC子网ID。获取方法如下：
  • 方法一：登录网络控制台界面，单击VPC下的子网，进入子网详情页面，查找子网ID。
  • 方法二：您可以通过 查询子网列表 subnetID字段获取。","lowerObject":"","example":"subnet-gr36jdeyt0"},{"support_auto_recovery":"securityGroupId","isRequir":"是","paramType":"String","describe":"安全组ID。获取方法如下：
  • 方法一：登录网络控制台界面，在安全组的详情页面查找安全组ID。
  • 方法二：您可以通过 查询用户安全组列表 id字段获取。","lowerObject":"","example":"sg-ufrtt04xq1"},{"support_auto_recovery":"instanceNum","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Integer","describe":"购买数量，取值范围1~100，默认值1。","lowerObject":"","example":"1"},{"support_auto_recovery":"enableIpv6","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Boolean","describe":"是否启用IPv6，默认为false。
  • true：启用IPv6。
  • false：不启用IPv6，默认值。","lowerObject":"","example":"false"},{"support_auto_recovery":"ipList","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Array of Strings","describe":"自定义ip，不能填入已使用了的ip，已使用的ip可通过 查看子网已使用IP API接口查询。具体哪些可使用的ip，可以通过新查询VPC列表 API接口查询子网网段范围。 注意：enableIpv6为true时不支持此参数。","lowerObject":"","example":"[\"192.168.3.45\",\"192.168.3.46\",\"192.168.3.47\"]"},{"support_auto_recovery":"plainPort","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Integer","describe":"公共接入点(PLAINTEXT)端口，范围在8000到9100之间，且不能是内部占用端口8093,8094,8095,8099,8190,8192,8194,8198和9011到9020之间。默认为8090。","lowerObject":"","example":"8090"},{"support_auto_recovery":"saslPort","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Integer","describe":"安全接入点(SASL_PLAINTEXT)端口，范围在8000到9100之间，且不能是内部占用端口8093,8094,8095,8099,8190,8192,8194,8198和9011到9020之间。默认为8092。","lowerObject":"","example":"8092"},{"support_auto_recovery":"sslPort","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Integer","describe":"SSL接入点(SASL_SSL)端口，范围在8000到9100之间，且不能是内部占用端口8093,8094,8095,8099,8190,8192,8194,8198和9011到9020之间。默认为8098。","lowerObject":"","example":"8098"},{"support_auto_recovery":"httpPort","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Integer","describe":"HTTP接入点端口，范围在8000到9100之间，且不能是内部占用端口8093,8094,8095,8099,8190,8192,8194,8198和9011到9020之间。默认为8082。","lowerObject":"","example":"8082"},{"support_auto_recovery":"retentionHours","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Integer","describe":"实例消息保留时长，可选1~10000小时，默认为72小时。","lowerObject":"","example":"72"},{"support_auto_recovery":"autoRenewStatus","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Boolean","describe":"过期是否自动续订。默认为false。
  • true：自动续订。
  • false：不自动续订，默认值。","lowerObject":"","example":"false"},{"support_auto_recovery":"autoRenewCycleCount","isRequir":"否","paramType":"Integer","describe":"自动续订时间长，单位为月，当autoRenewStatus为true时必填，取值：1~6,12,24,36。","lowerObject":"","example":"1"}]}}]
